In my interdisciplinary research group and driving simulation laboratory at the CARISSMA research center of Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt (Germany), we investigate safe and sustainable solutions for the mobility of the future.

We are currently looking for a Research Engineer (m/f/d) in XR and Human-AI Interaction for Automated Driving.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and developing XR (Extended Reality) applications using Unity, Unreal Engine, CARLA, or comparable frameworks
• Integrating psychophysiological measurement technologies, including data processing and analysis (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python)
• Developing adaptive and intelligent Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Explainable User Interfaces, and Human-AI Interaction concepts
• Designing and conducting user studies in the fields of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Human-AI Interaction, and automated driving
• Data-driven modeling of human behavior (e.g., driver behavior, vulnerable road users, state/trait analyses)
• Conducting independent research and publishing scientific results (—> to obtain PhD)

Are you interested in researching at the intersection of humans and technology and actively contributing to the vision of safe autonomous mobility? Then we would be delighted to hear from you!

•

Application deadline: June 12, 2026

•

100% full-time position

•

TV-L E13 salary scale

•

Initial contract duration: 2 years, with the possibility of extension

•

Excellent English skills (C1) and good German language skills (B2), both written and spoken, are required!
